operating_notes.text: Paper remains the sole reportable operating segment.
Hon'ble NCLAT heard and reserved orders on the sole remaining appeal challenging NCLT sale of Servalakshmi Paper Limited assets.
Total paper capacity is 2,55,000 tonnes p.a. (Erode and Tirunelveli combined) with 97% capacity utilisation.
Effective shareholding in associate Ponni Sugars (Erode) Limited increased to 35.78% following acquisition of 2.90 lakh shares.
Remaining appeal regarding Servalakshmi Paper Limited assets heard and reserved for orders by Hon'ble NCLAT.

timeline.summary: High Energy Batteries (India) Limited (V Anantha Subramanian) declared no encumbrance on Seshasayee Paper and Boards Limited shares during FY2026.
Ponni Sugars (Erode) Limited’s promoter, Madhusudhan RSPO, declared under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) that it held no equity shares of Seshasayee Paper and Boards Limited as of March 31, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹591.84 Cr (+17.8% YoY), net profit ₹26.05 Cr (-3.8% YoY).
Seshasayee Paper and Boards Limited’s Board of Directors recommended a final dividend of ₹2.00 per equity share for FY2025-26 on May 12, 2026.
Seshasayee Paper approved ₹25 Cr capex to augment copier paper conversion facilities over 6 months from June 2026.

Seshasayee Paper and Boards Limited’s promoters—N. Gopalaratnam (78,155 shares, 0.12%), Ponni Sugars (Erode) Limited (8,840,905 shares, 14.02%), and others—declared no encumbrance on shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹503.06 Cr (+45.3% YoY), net profit ₹42.31 Cr (+88.8% YoY).
